attempts.sql: WITH echo_syms AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.file_id = 'src/click/utils.py' AND s.name = 'echo'), direct AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM code.calls c JOIN echo_syms e ON e.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE cf.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%' AND cf.is_test = FALSE AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE '%examples%' AND cs.kind IN ('function','method') GROUP BY c.caller_symbol_id) SELECT caller_symbol_id, CAST(n AS INTEGER) AS call_sites FROM direct ORDER BY caller_symbol_id
